scope: Native RTX research pilot, not CI performance. All arms use same256windows and same references. H1/P are intentionally modified backward directions; original forward objectives and true native AD checks retained.
gradient_placement: Identity boundary after every corrected physical state, before intermediate loss and recurrence. H1 filters velocity in closed curl space and Neumann heat, preserving heat constant mode.
compute_accounting: Each update executes candidate value-gradient AND separate trueAD value-gradient for all arms, then Adam; both calls included in update time. Checkpoint clocks include validation and prior diagnostics. Persistent cache may be warm.
